response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, frameworks), and clear leadership in open-source and knowledge-sharing, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Proven track record in building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Demonstrated technical leadership via open-source projects and workshops
Broad cross-platform experience including mobile (iOS/Apple TV) and build systems
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership beyond technical mentorship
Limited visibility into strategic roadmap planning or organizational change initiatives
Mobile platform experience is ad hoc (iOS app takeover) rather than systemic or scalable
